lines.en: I come through the fallen leaves.
I walk disguised as a timber wolf.

lines.zh: 我的步子学着狼的样子
lines.en: I copy a wolf's gait.
I circle the trees slowly.
I come out of the thicket.
I go with my nose to the ground.
My shadow is not quite right.
My false fur sways in the tree shadows
I brush past a trunk.
I pace the edge of the clearing.
A patch of my fur is false.
I walk slowly, properly.
I stand as if listening.
I stand firm on four legs.

lines.zh: 我眼睛里没有狼的神色
lines.en: No wolf looks out of these eyes
I wait for the woods to go quiet.
I play wolf, but my tail will not wag
I turn my ears slowly.
There are no prints under me.
My smell is wrong.
I am watching your back.
I lie so still not a hair twitches.
I lift a forepaw.
I am waiting for a moment.
A small sound sits in my throat.
I lower my head again.

lines.zh: 我不像看起来那么像狼
lines.en: I am not as wolf-like as I look.
I hold my body taut.
I am watching the gaps between trees.

lines.zh: 我始终保持着这个姿势
lines.en: I keep this pose throughout.
I raise my head; my eyes are too bright.
I wag my tail once.
Does this shape look right to you?
I tip my head at you.
My ears sit a little wrong.
I circle to the tree behind you
I have your scent.
I will not pretend much longer.
Can you see the seams?
I open my mouth; there are too many teeth.
I pace slowly around you.
You have turned your back to me.
I fall back two steps.
I growl and cower.
My hide has slipped aside.
My smell grows stronger.
I grit my teeth.
My hind leg drags once.
I crouch and let the pelt hug the grass.
I twist my head and look at you.
I brace against the tree.

lines.zh: 我还没露出全部的样子
lines.en: I have not shown my whole shape.
You wave that at me.
I do not want that.
I am only interested in prey.
One sniff and I look away.
That will not buy me.
I go around what you hold.
For prey, I only see the throat
Holding it will not stop me.
I give a thin smile.
That is not what I want.
You hit me and I do not budge.
I turn aside.

lines.zh: 我的皮晃了一下，不太自然
lines.en: My hide shifts; it does not look natural.
You shrink back a step.
Something rolls in my throat.
You slide past my flank.
The knock shakes my coat.
I slowly turn to face you.
My pelt slides crooked under your feet
I retreat to the tree.
Another comes out of the woods.
It too is dressed as a wolf.
We circle and look each other over.
Neither of our shadows is right.
It is more convincing than I.
We lower our heads together.
No cry passes between us.
It sets off first.
We fade behind the trees.
We were never wolves.
I lower my head and take it.
This hide is the wrong shape to wear
I carry it off.
I grind it into the mud.

lines.zh: 我这张皮是从狼身上拿的。
lines.en: I took this hide off a wolf.
I drop it and leave it.
In deer hide, I walk like a deer.
I do not even chew.
I spit out the bone.
I lift my snout and sniff.
My feet nail themselves down.
I square my head at you.
This hide isn't mine.
The pretending ends here.
My wolf hide slips.
I flatten low and gather force.
Every sound in the woods is gone.
I take one step toward you.
You are not getting away.
I open my mouth; the teeth are wrong.
I follow you, my steps light.

lines.zh: 我把身体压低到草丛里
lines.en: I sink into the grass.
Each time you look back, I stop.
I am measuring the pounce.
My legs tremble with held energy.
That sound you heard was no wolf.
I drop low and hug the grass
I wait for your back to turn more.
I never meant to spare you.
That is not wind in the grass.
I lunge hard.
I snap at your shoulder.

lines.zh: 爪子从你袖子上撕下来
lines.en: Claws tear down the sleeve of your arm
I slam into you screaming.
I miss and hit the tree.
I twist and lunge again.
You are knocked onto your back.

lines.zh: 我的牙咬住了你的衣角
lines.en: My teeth catch your coat.
I shake my head and drag you.
I leap over your head.
I pace out from between the trees.

lines.zh: 我装成一只狼慢慢靠近
lines.en: I come closer in a wolf's shape.
My shadow gets there before me.
A pair of eyes appears in the shade.
I lower my head and sniff.
I pace half a circle around you.
My coat looks wrong in the light.
I stand at the clearing's edge.

lines.zh: 我身后的脚印只有一半
lines.en: Only half of my prints show.
I make no sound at all.
I raise the false wolf's face.
My scent is on this ground now.

lines.zh: 烟花炸开，我尖叫着退开
lines.en: Fireworks burst and I scream and recoil.
I roll down the slope.
Water pours in through this borrowed muzzle
The blast peels my hide open.

lines.zh: 有东西扎进了我的身体
lines.en: Something lodges in my body.
Spell light tears my disguise.

lines.zh: 林子里没有能扑的东西
lines.en: Nothing left in these woods to pounce on

lines.zh: 雷光把我的影子照得太清
lines.en: Lightning shows my shadow too clearly.
There is nothing under my feet.
